messages:
Alex: Heads-up — support flagged 3 tickets requesting per-tenant rate limit overrides for Dedicated customers (ACME, BoxCo, PartnerX). They look like the same ask, with minor wording differences. Should we fold into a single canonical backlog item?

ProductOps: +1 fold. Proposed canonical summary: "Per-tenant rate limit override (Dedicated) — admin controls & API". Tagging: customer-ask, dedicated, infra, billing.

Maya (support): here's the original ticket snippets: ACME wants emergency bump for marketing blast; BoxCo wants per-team cap; PartnerX needs SLA exceptions. They all want UI + API.

Jess: Acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) Admin UI to set tenant-level limits, 2) API for programmatic overrides, 3) auditing + KMS-safe logs, 4) rollout gated to Dedicated customers behind feature flag, 5) regression tests + perf SLO verified.

Kevin: assign owner and notify each account. Who will do comms to requesters? Sales needs standardized status updates.

Alex: @Jess can you own the canonical item? Also @Maya can you send the following template to each requester and ping me if any customer insists on higher priority?

Template:
```
Hi {{customer}},
Thanks for the request — we're consolidating similar customer asks into a single engineering backlog item to prioritize scope and rollout. Current status: triage + owner assigned. Next update: we expect to share scope + timing within 2 weeks.
If you need expedited handling, please reply with business impact (lost revenue, SLA breach, regulatory need) and a contact for escalation.

– Support
```

ProductOps: Tags to add in ZenHub/Jira: `customer-ask`, `dedicated`, `priority:P2`, `requires-security-review`. Add note: "merge three intake tickets; link original ticket IDs: #4521, #4560, #4599".

Maya (support): Sent template to ACME/BoxCo/PartnerX. ACME replied with "marketing blast; potential $120k ARR risk" — per Sales, ACME will push for faster timeline.

Jess: I'll take ownership. Creating canonical ticket now and will include acceptance criteria + rough ETA. Will add canary rollout plan and fallback to hosted API variant.

Kevin: Please CC sales@ when you post the scope. We'll coordinate any expedited support if ACME escalates.

Alex: Thanks — let's reuse this workflow for future duplicates. Small ask — can we make a short doc with steps for triage/merge so support can do initial merge and tag? That would reduce back-and-forth.

ProductOps: Good idea. I'll draft a 1-pager and add to /docs/triage/merge-flow. Will @channel when ready.

SupportBot: Ticket merge completed. Parent: #4601. Children: #4521, #4560, #4599. Assigned: Jess. Status: triaged.

Jess: Parent ticket created: #4601. ETA: research + spec by 2026-04-05. Will post updates in this thread.

Alex: :thumbsup:
